gloss: a bit more; somewhat more; on the larger side

definitions.gloss: a bit more; somewhat more; on the larger side
definitions.explanation: An amount or quantity that is slightly larger than usual or than what is strictly required. The suffix め attaches to adjectives or quantity words to mean 'on the X side.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{多|おお}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please add a little more salt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{多|おお}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕入|しい}れて→仕入れる：11430_shiireru⟧おいた。
examples.english: Since customers increase on weekends, I stocked up on a bit more ingredients.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ (many, much) + the suffix め (tendency toward, slightly on the X side). Most often used adverbially as {多|おお}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多|おお}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: put in a bit more
- {多|おお}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: make a bit more
- {多|おお}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見積|みつ}もる→見積もる：14132_mitsumoru⟧: estimate on the high side
- {多|おお}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: a somewhat larger amount

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{少|すく}なめ→少なめ：19120_sukuname⟧: a bit less — the opposite, used in the same way
- ⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧: plenty; a lot — emphasizes generous quantity, stronger than {多|おお}め
- ⟦{大|おお}きめ→大きめ：21239_ookime⟧: a bit larger (in size) — uses め with size rather than quantity
